newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wing Lung signs HK$3 bln CD programme.
newsitem.headline: Wing Lung signs HK$3 bln CD programme.

text.p: Wing Lung Bank Ltd has signed a HK$3.0 billion certificates of deposit issuance programme with 10 financial institutions, the bank said on Thursday.

The programme provides for both Hong Kong dollar and U.S. dollar issues in the form of floating rate, fixed rate and discounted certificates of deposit. Put and call options can be incorporated under the terms of the individual issues.

DKB Asia, Fuji International Finance (HK), HSBC Markets, Jardine Fleming Bank, Sakura Finance Asia, Schroders Asia, Societe Generale Asia, Union Bank of Switzerland's Hong Kong branch, Westdeutsche Landesbank and Westpac Banking Corp's Hong Kong branch are dealers for the programme.
HSBC Markets is the arranger for the programme and the Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corp is acting as reference and paying agent.
Wing Lung Bank is rated Baa1 by Moody's Investor Services and BBB-pi by Standard and Poor's Corp.
